title: McCasland-DeLonge contacts as a disclosure operation meant to pave the way for a Hillary Clinton presidency

tellings.quote: when I say op, it's not a bad thing. That was an operation, meaning there were people trying to get [ __ ] out.

plain: A filmmaker and journalist named Jeremy Corbell, speaking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes contacts in 2015 and 2016 between Neil McCasland, a retired Air Force general, and Tom DeLonge, a rock musician who started a public effort to reveal UFO secrets, all of it surfacing in emails published by WikiLeaks, a website that posts leaked documents. Corbell says these contacts were an "operation", which he says was not a bad thing: people on the inside trying to get information out, meant to prepare the ground for a Hillary Clinton presidency. He cites the journalist George Knapp, and if he is right, insiders were quietly working toward official disclosure.
